items.detail: The current Decision Graph snapshot does not contain the Scanpy contract node although the local contract and capability pack bind Scanpy 1.11.2.
PCA scaled/log-HVG and neighbors PCA/integrated variants are explicitly scoped governed product profiles, not universal upstream API requirements.
n_comps, n_neighbors, random_state, resolution, flavor, use_rep and neighbors_key are referenced by current contracts but are not yet reconstructed as first-class Parameter entities in this slice.
All reconstructed claim revisions and CAN_FEED derivations remain candidate pending review.

resolved_items.decision: Official Scanpy 1.11.2 source is pinned to the release tag commit and PyPI sdist digest; 19 bounded candidate EvidenceSpans cover all five operators.
scanpy.pp.pca is canonical; scanpy.tl.pca is a release-scoped compatibility alias resolving to the same preprocessing function, not a second OperatorRevision.
seurat/cell_ranger require log-transformed input; seurat_v3/seurat_v3_paper require raw count input.
The output is one structured representation with required connectivities, distances, and metadata components; UMAP requires connectivities+metadata and Leiden requires connectivities.
